normalized.result: Yes, that feels right. Searching `quantum-banana` matched nothing, and instead of leaving me staring at a blank space wondering if something broke, it showed a clear no-results message so I know the search simply found nothing. Then "Clear search" brought my whole collection straight back. That's exactly what I'd want — an empty search should tell me plainly that there's nothing to show, and getting back to everything should be one easy step. Good.
